name: Scandinavian minimalism

influenced_by: Nordic craft traditions and long dark winters favoring light interiors

eras: c. 1930s onward; international visibility from a landmark 1954–57 touring exhibition, "Design in Scandinavia"
garments: not primarily a fashion look — furniture and interior design

media.title: Alvar Aalto's furniture and architecture (1930s on)

reacts_against: ornate historical furniture styles, favoring function, light wood, and pale, high-reflectance colors suited to long, dark Nordic winters.
